title: WaferLLM: Large Language Model Inference at Wafer Scale
problem: Deploying LLM inference on specialized wafer-scale systems (Cerebras WSE2) requires new programming models and collective communication patterns not supported by standard frameworks
motivation: Wafer-scale accelerators offer massive parallelism for LLM inference but require system-specific optimizations to fully utilize their bandwidth and computation. Standard approaches waste accelerator potential
method: Introduces PLMR (Pipelined Local MeshGEMM Reduction) model and MeshGEMM/MeshGEMV collective operations specifically designed for wafer-scale mesh topology
key_novelty: First comprehensive system for LLM inference on wafer-scale accelerators with specialized GEMM/GEMV implementations that exploit mesh interconnect topology
contributions: PLMR programming model for pipelined tensor operations across wafer mesh
MeshGEMM collective operation for matrix multiplication
MeshGEMV collective operation for matrix-vector operations
200x improvement in accelerator utilization vs naive approach
10-20x speedup vs A100 GPU clusters on LLM inference
limitations: Limited to Cerebras WSE2 hardware; requires completely different programming model than standard frameworks; high barrier to adoption; applicability to other wafer-scale systems unclear
